evidence: Includes picking, packing, and shipping orders, as well as handling customer service and returns.

evidence: we will expand the returns processing fee to apply to high return-rate products in all categories, excluding apparel and shoes.

claim: Under the FBA New Selection program, Amazon waives return processing costs for up to 200 units of each parent ASIN.

claim: For the New Selection waiver, returned items must be received at a fulfillment center within 120 days of the first date the inventory was received.
evidence: Returned items have to be received at a fulfillment center within 120 days of the first date the inventory was received.

claim: New Selection eligibility requires an Inventory Performance Index (IPI) of 300 or higher.
evidence: Have an Inventory Performance Index (IPI) of 300 or higher

claim: New-to-FBA parent ASINs are those that have never been received at an Amazon fulfillment center before.
evidence: meaning they have never been received at an Amazon fulfillment center before.

claim: Amazon charges return processing fees for items returned through Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF).
evidence: Amazon charges return processing fees for items returned through MCF.

evidence: Return fees are based on the product's size tier and weight and include return logistics transportation, regrading, and restocking.

claim: The MCF return fee for small standard items up to 4 oz is $3.22.
The MCF return fee for small standard items over 12 oz to 16 oz is $3.55.
The MCF return fee for large standard items over 1 lb to 2 lb is $4.70.
evidence: > 1 lb to 2 lbs $4.70

claim: The MCF return fee for large standard items over 3 lb to 20 lb is $5.60 plus $0.40 per lb above 3 lb.
evidence: > 3 lbs to 20 lbs $5.60 + $0.40/lb above 3 lbs

claim: The MCF return fee for small bulky items up to 30 lb is $8.65 plus $0.40 per lb above 2 lb.
evidence: ≤ 30 lbs $8.65 + $0.40/lb above 2 lbs
